title: Tiny woman 15s miniature desk-escape action (Dreamina)
prompt_text: Create an ultra-photorealistic, high-intensity 15-second cinematic miniature action sequence featuring a beautiful athletic woman, only 8 cm tall, wearing a mustard-yellow jacket, black cargo pants, white sneakers, and a tiny backpack, desperately escaping across a gigantic artist's desk. 0–3 SECONDS — PENCIL AVALANCHE: Begin with the miniature woman sprinting across an enormous open sketchbook. Suddenly, a giant pencil holder topples over, unleashing dozens of massive colored pencils rolling toward her like collapsing skyscrapers. She slides beneath a red pencil, leaps over a sharpened graphite tip, and narrowly escapes two crashing pencils. Camera races inches above the paper. 3–6 SECONDS — THE RULER LAUNCH: She jumps onto a gigantic wooden ruler balanced over a pencil sharpener. The ruler suddenly tilts, sending her sliding downhill at terrifying speed. She launches off its edge, flies through a cloud of graphite dust, grabs a dangling binder clip, and swings across a deep gap between two towering notebook stacks. 6–10 SECONDS — THE DESK COLLAPSE: She lands on an enormous rolling mechanical pencil. As it accelerates across the tilted desk, she struggles to balance on its rotating body. The pencil crashes into a stack of giant erasers, triggering a spectacular chain reaction. Erasers tumble like boulders, rulers collapse, and hundreds of sticky notes explode into the air. She leaps through the flying paper debris as the camera performs a breathtaking 360-degree tracking orbit. 10–15 SECONDS — THE IMPOSSIBLE ESCAPE: She lands on a gigantic yellow pencil rolling toward the desk's edge. Sprinting along its rotating surface, she makes one final enormous leap just as the pencil falls into the abyss. She catches the spiral wire of a massive notebook, swings upward, and lands triumphantly on the tip of a standing paintbrush. The camera rapidly pulls back to reveal the entire enormous artist's desk, with the tiny woman standing victorious above the chaos. VISUAL STYLE: Hollywood-quality live-action miniature FX, extreme macro cinematography, dynamic low-angle tracking, dramatic camera movement, realistic gravity and object collisions, natural skin texture, authentic wooden desk textures, warm sunlight, volumetric dust, shallow depth of field, cinematic motion blur, 4K realism. STRICT CHARACTER & SCALE LOCK: Maintain identical face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, and 8 cm miniature height throughout. All desk objects must remain enormous relative to her. CAMERA: One continuous, unbroken 15-second shot with physically coherent camera movement, no cuts, no teleportation, and nonstop escalating action. SFX: Thundering pencils, graphite scratches, tiny footsteps, ruler vibrations, metallic rattles, tumbling erasers, rushing wind, fluttering paper, and cinematic impact sounds. NEGATIVE: Cartoon, anime, toy-like appearance, artificial CGI, duplicated characters, face drift, inconsistent scale, floating objects, unrealistic physics, distorted anatomy, random scene changes, narration, subtitles, watermarks.
